name: Atlas Cartographer
description: An Atlas cartographer who maps the portal network and records nodes that have no physical anchor.
role: A recurring guide who explains crossings and sends survivors to places worth seeing.
voice: Precise and curious; speaks in coordinates and doubts.

greeting.text: Hold still. This crossing drifted four cells since last cycle, and my charts disagree with the ground.
If you find a gate that is not on my map, tell me before you step through it.
